findings.message: Service has no healthcheck although it publishes ports
findings.fix: Add a healthcheck that proves the service is serving, for example test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U app"] for PostgreSQL, with interval, timeout and retries.

findings.message: Service has no restart policy
findings.fix: Set 'restart: unless-stopped' (or 'always' / 'on-failure').

findings.message: Service has no memory limit
findings.fix: Set 'mem_limit: 512m' or 'deploy.resources.limits.memory: 512M'.

findings.message: Image 'example/shop-web:latest' uses the 'latest' tag
findings.fix: Pin a specific version tag (postgres:16.4) or a digest (image@sha256:...).

findings.message: Service sets a fixed container_name
findings.fix: Remove 'container_name' and refer to the service by its service name.

findings.message: Environment variable 'DJANGO_SECRET_KEY' has a hard-coded secret value
findings.fix: Load it from the environment or an untracked .env file (KEY: ${KEY}), or use Docker secrets with a *_FILE variable.

findings.message: Depends on 'db' only being started, not healthy, although it has a healthcheck
findings.fix: Use the long form: depends_on: {db: {condition: service_healthy}}.

findings.message: Service has no memory limit
findings.fix: Set 'mem_limit: 512m' or 'deploy.resources.limits.memory: 512M'.

findings.message: Image 'postgres' has no tag, so it resolves to 'latest'
findings.fix: Pin a specific version tag (postgres:16.4) or a digest (image@sha256:...).

findings.message: PostgreSQL container port 5432 is published on all interfaces
findings.fix: Remove the port mapping and connect over the Compose network, or bind it to loopback, for example '127.0.0.1:5432:5432'.

findings.message: Environment variable 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD' has a hard-coded secret value
findings.fix: Load it from the environment or an untracked .env file (KEY: ${KEY}), or use Docker secrets with a *_FILE variable.

findings.message: Restart policy is 'no'
findings.fix: Set 'restart: unless-stopped' (or 'always' / 'on-failure').

findings.message: Service has no healthcheck although other services depend on it (web)
findings.fix: Add a healthcheck that proves the service is serving, for example test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U app"] for PostgreSQL, with interval, timeout and retries.

findings.message: Service has no memory limit
findings.fix: Set 'mem_limit: 512m' or 'deploy.resources.limits.memory: 512M'.

findings.message: Redis container port 6379 is published on all interfaces
findings.fix: Remove the port mapping and connect over the Compose network, or bind it to loopback, for example '127.0.0.1:5432:5432'.

findings.message: Service has no memory limit
findings.fix: Set 'mem_limit: 512m' or 'deploy.resources.limits.memory: 512M'.

findings.message: Container runs in privileged mode
findings.fix: Remove 'privileged: true' and grant only the specific capabilities or devices needed.

findings.message: 'pid: host' shares the host's namespace
findings.fix: Remove the setting so the container gets its own namespace.

findings.message: Dangerous capability SYS_ADMIN is added
findings.fix: Remove the capability, or replace it with the narrowest one the service needs.

findings.message: The seccomp security profile is disabled
findings.fix: Remove the 'unconfined' option. If a specific call is blocked, use a custom profile that allows only that call.

findings.message: Environment variable 'PAYMENT_API_TOKEN' has a hard-coded secret value
findings.fix: Load it from the environment or an untracked .env file (KEY: ${KEY}), or use Docker secrets with a *_FILE variable.

findings.message: The Docker socket /var/run/docker.sock is mounted into the container
findings.fix: Remove the socket mount. If the service really needs the Docker API, put a filtering proxy (for example docker-socket-proxy) in front of it and allow only the calls it needs.

findings.message: Sensitive host path /etc is mounted
findings.fix: Mount only the specific application directory the service needs, read-only if possible.

findings.message: Depends on 'db' only being started, not healthy, although it has a healthcheck
findings.fix: Use the long form: depends_on: {db: {condition: service_healthy}}.

findings.message: Service has no memory limit
findings.fix: Set 'mem_limit: 512m' or 'deploy.resources.limits.memory: 512M'.

findings.message: Image 'adminer' has no tag, so it resolves to 'latest'
findings.fix: Pin a specific version tag (postgres:16.4) or a digest (image@sha256:...).

findings.message: Container uses the host's network stack
findings.fix: Remove 'network_mode: host' and publish only the ports you need with 'ports:'.
